title: WEIRDO: WEak resIdual Regularized DOob's h-transform diffusion alignment
abstract: arXiv:2609.39531v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the problem of estimating the guidance that steers the distribution learned by a diffusion generative model toward a tilted target $q_0 \propto w\,p_0$ at inference time. Relying on the stochastic optimal control approach, we observe that the exact drift correction is the gradient of the logarithm of Doob's $h$-function, and we study the problem of estimating it from a sample. In the present paper, we assume that the score of the pretrained model is available, that the tilting weight is bounded and positive, and that the reference distribution has a bounded support, no smoothness of the weight is required. Introducing a penalized least-squares risk in which the penalty is the residual of the space-time harmonicity equation satisfied by the $h$-function, measured in a dual Sobolev norm, we derive high-probability bounds on the squared error of the resulting guidance estimate. translated_title: WEIRDO：弱残差正则化Doob's h-变换扩散对齐
translated_abstract: 我们研究在推理时估计引导项的问题，该引导项将扩散生成模型所学习的分布推向一个倾斜的目标分布 $q_0 \propto w\,p_0$。依托随机最优控制方法，我们观察到精确的漂移修正项是Doob's $h$-函数的对数的梯度，并研究从样本中估计该梯度的问题。在本文中，我们假设预训练模型的得分函数是可用的，倾斜权重有界且为正，参考分布具有有界支撑，且无需对权重作任何光滑性假设。通过引入一个带惩罚的最小二乘风险，其中惩罚项是 $h$-函数所满足的时空调和方程的残差（以对偶Sobolev范数度量），我们推导出所得引导估计的平方误差的高概率界。由于惩罚项在目标处消失，该估计……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出WEIRDO方法，以Doob's h-函数所满足的时空调和方程残差作为惩罚项构建带惩罚最小二乘风险来估计扩散模型的推理时引导项，并在倾斜权重无光滑性要求的条件下推导出估计误差的高概率界。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes WEIRDO, which estimates inference-time guidance for diffusion models via a penalized least-squares risk whose penalty is the space-time harmonicity equation residual of Doob's h-function, deriving high-probability error bounds without requiring any smoothness of the tilting weight.
